change: Show HQ the durable starting position after a skip-ahead event read

review.decision: Keep a preview readable and report the safe retry start on stderr
review.notes: The installed supervisor recovered from an ahead-of-watermark read by using the actual stored cursor. Preserve the existing receipt guard, JSON records and exit code. Show the diagnostic only for a contiguous, unfiltered HQ read that started ahead. No acknowledge, replay, producer state or cross-role change.

cases.description: HQ reads ahead without skipping debt and receives the safe retry cursor
cases.setup: Synthetic HQ and retained event journal with a persisted cursor behind the requested sequence.
cases.action: Read an unfiltered JSON delta from the forward cursor, then retry from the documented durable value. Inspect stderr, JSON output, exit codes and the persisted cursor.
cases.expected: The preview remains a successful parseable read. Stderr explains why the watermark did not advance and gives the exact safe retry command. Retrying reads the skipped records and advances through the retained tail.
